Existing runner.execute incrementally hashes all drained bytes and retains bounded prefixes. UTF-8 replacement decoding is lossy for invalid input, but exact UTF-8 re-encoding hash AND byte-length equality makes proposed acceptance fail closed. Overflow, ambiguous completion and timeout must independently exclude acceptance.

CLI run prints only a summary. Full execute return is persisted by store.finish as reservations.receipt_json and, for verified reproduction, event payload. Root must recover from that exact reservation, with runnerDigest/candidate/action/charge matching, rather than interpreting CLI stdout as the raw result.

Existing bound-runner schema admits timeout20/grace5/charge60: load_runner requires at least20+5+30=55. execute has a further wait(timeout=5) after its outer cutoff, so retaining the full60 debit is necessary; the5 seconds are not reusable credit. No tighter universal wall-clock completion guarantee is inferred from source.

Nix registered requisite/NAR identities are an explicit trusted OS/store boundary, not an independent transitive byte verification. Full K package hashes and selected executable hashes strengthen that scoped boundary without requiring a159-package rebuild.

mandatoryImplementationChecks.requirement: Account for Foreman user namespace ownership before spending the grant. Launcher prefers --user --map-current-user, so host UID0 may appear as overflow UID65534. Do not require literal child st_uid==0 or treat arbitrary overflow UID as proven host-root ownership. Revalidate host root ownership in the host-side final read-only admission inspection; pin that evidence and validate the namespace mapping plus effective non-writability in the child. If this ownership relation cannot be established, stop before dispatch. Exercise the final preflight under actual strong containment with exec injected/harmless target.

Check actual wrapper PATH modifications and parser shebang resolution; a minimal inherited environment alone does not demonstrate those selections.
